```lean
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have h₁ : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by grind
  have h₂ : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAᶜ
    have h₃ : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by ext x; simp
    have h₄ : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ hAᶜ
    rw [h₃] at h₄; contradiction
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := Finset.univ \ P
  have h₃ : P.card = Q.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    <;> simp [h₁, h₂, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ]
  have h₄ : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₅ : P.card + Q.card = Finset.univ.card := by
      rw [← Finset.card_union_add_card_inter P Q]
      simp [Finset.union_eq_univ, Finset.inter_eq_empty]
    rw [h₅]
    simp [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
  have h₅ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := by positivity
  have h₆ : 2 * P.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by rw [h₃] at h₄; linarith
  have h₇ : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₈ : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by omega
    calc
      2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 ^ 1 := by rfl
      _ = 2 ^ ((Fintype.card S - 1) + 1) := by rw [← pow_add]
      _ = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by rw [h₈]
  omega
```
